title: IS17_interface2_6

lines.explanation: Creates an interface called Shape.
Declares the area() method as public and type double.
Declares the volume() method as public and type double.
Creates a class called Cube that implements the Shape interface.
Initializes width as an integer with the value 2.
Initializes length as an integer with the value 3.
Initializes height as an integer with the value 10.
Defines the area() method.
Displays the value of width *height (which is 20).
Defines the volume() method with return type double.
Displays the volume of the Shape by multiplying the width, length, and height.
Creates a class called Circle which implements the Shape interface.
Initializes the variable radius as an integer with the value of 10.
Uses the area() method.
Displays the area of the circle by multiplying Math.PI * radius * radius.
Defines the volume() method.
Displays a 0 for the Volume of the circle.
Creates a class called PolymorphismTest.
Declares the static, main method.

lines.code: Shape[] s = { new Cube(), new Circle() };
lines.explanation: Creates a new interface Shape called s that uses the newCube() and new Circle() class.
Starts a for loop for the list s that will continue for the length of the list.  Starts at position [0] using the vairable i.

lines.code: System.out.println("The area and volume of " + s[i].getClass() " is " + s[i].area() + " , " + s[i].volume());
lines.explanation:
Will display the area and volume of each class.  It begins with the class i = 0 and moves down the list until s.length has been reached.  Prints: "The area and volume of" Class "is" area, volume.

Note: the + is missing after s[i].getClass().
